subtopic: Impact of Fees on Investment Returns
source_evidence: Fees and other costs reduce your return on your investments, and can have a significant impact on the overall return of your investments over time.
answer: Miscellaneous broker fees are costs that may be charged for expenses related to a transaction or service. These charges reduce the return you keep from your investments, and their impact can become significant over time. When reviewing investment costs, pay attention to miscellaneous fees as well as commissions.
